recipes.title: Fuckin Spring Rolls
recipes.headnote: This is the one. I won’t sugar coat it; this is a bitch to make, so make a lot. Recruit friends, make a day of it. This will get you remembered.

items.name: egg roll wraps
items.note: spring roll wraps might work; lumpia wraps break too easily

items: Cook ground turkey
Soak bean starch noodles
Prep all veggies
Microwave noodles and chop to 1"
Mix all ingredients (not eggs, wraps) in a bowl
Heat 1" of oil in a large pan/wok

Put a dollop of mixture in a wrap and roll up tight, sealing with egg (too tight and they will burst; too little egg and the roll can come undone in the pan; don’t make more than 10 ahead of cooking, they'll dry out and break)
slide in oil from the side of the pan
use tongs to flip when the bottom is brown
put cooked rolls on paper towels to drain and soak

notes: Eat as you go; you deserve the extras.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese
recipes.headnote: I’ll try not to overcomplicate this, but this was Frankenstein's monster of a leftover night that ended up being one of the best meals I’ve ever assembled. A wicked sleeper that, if plated with some rosemary & diligence, would blow any date night out of the water.
recipes.yield: DON'T SHARE THIS THEY CAN MAKE THEIR OWN (your words from the future, not mine)

items: Grate 1T parmesan
Slice focaccia
Debone your ribs
Heat your pan to medium-high and toss a healthy dollop of butter onto the pan. Brown it. Melt, froth, foam, and stir like crazy so it doesn't stick or ash.
Rub one side of sliced focaccia with salt and parmesan and lay face down
Top with cheese and ribs
Same treatment to the other slice and set it on top.
Flip and dance, and don’t spill it everywhere.

notes: I used a beloved panini press, so the pan directions are a little bit of a guess. However, I bet a cast iron treatment would smack.

recipes.title: Hot Philly Cheesesteaks
recipes.headnote: The New Staple. I’ve been asking everyone to pick me up a hot Philly for 6 years, and I recently discovered just how easy it is to make one.

items: Heat a cast iron pan on medium
Thinly slice half of your yellow onion. Shoot for 1/8th” or thinner
Drop your butter underneath your onions on one half of the pan; in the other half, scoop in the Mama Lil’s. They can touch but can't canoodle
When your onions are golden and your peppers are charred, evenly distribute them into your hoagies.
Make two hoagie-shaped parallel piles of meat in your pan.
Top the meat with the Swiss
Pour in the water and cover the pan for about 30 seconds while the cheese turns into a gooey mess.
Scoop into your sandwiches
Grub

notes: Your South Philly impression isn’t as good as you think.

recipes.title: Larp Chicken & Sticky Rice
recipes.headnote: This is my mom’s favorite Thai dish. It’s just really fuckin good. You do need a thai rice basket for this.

items: 24 Hours Prior: Rinse sticky rice and soak overnight in room temperature water
Day Of: Chop all the veggie
Boil water in a rice pot
Drain water from soaking rice
Put rice in a Thai rice basket for 2 minutes, then flip
After 10 more minutes, flip
After 10 more minutes, flip
After 10 more minutes, put in a serving bowl or Thai rice basket
Fry in light oil-cook, don’t brown
Add ground rice
Add fish sauce
Add lime juice to taste
Add pepper flakes
Mix salad with ground chicken
Serve alongside rice

items: Soakin’ noods put the noodles in a larger bowl and let it soak for 30-45 minutes while you prep.
Mix your shit K put all your fish sauce, veggie oil, sriracha, & peanut butter in a teeny lil bowl
Solids this time. Insert some minced garlic, diced onions, sug’, pap’, peanuts, goin in a bow.
Scramble your eggs in a big ol pan (think wok sized) or a huge pot.
Add your solids and liquids.

Why did I have you place them separately? I’m an asshole. Jokes on you, idiot. Washing an extra bowl tonight cause Cody said so. Tosh saved you a dish; I wasted one. Entropy is everywhere. That’s what you get for using a cookbook both pad thai and chocolate cake, you maniac.
Take a breath. Calm down. I’m sorry. I didn’t mean it.

Chow time. bonus points if you panini press or bake the lil nugget.

recipes.title: Boozy Iced Coffee
recipes.headnote: It’s caffeinated. It’s creamy. It will put you flat on your ass. Inspired by the old-school iced Kahlua Kicker @ Dutch Bros.

items: Grind coffee beans mildly more coarse than you would for a traditional pot.
Put 300g ice in chemex; store in freezer
Boil ~1 liter water, let rest to 208ºF. If you don’t have a thermometer, give it about 2 minutes resting at room temp.
Bloom that batch. Pull out your chemex, toss in a fresh filter, dump your 30g of grind in and shake level. Set on scale & reset to 0 with grind & filter sitting over ice.

Slowly pour enough water to soak all the grind and stop. Rule of thumb is 2x the amount of grind (30g X 2 = 60ml), but if I can manage to soak all my grind with less water, I’ll stop. Don't reset your scale.

After blooming has stopped and the grind has sunk back, slowly pour in 300ml water and stop. I swirl the grind as it brews for an even extraction, but I have no evidence this actually works any better than just waiting. Should take around 4 minutes to brew. Tighten or loosen your grind to fit your taste.
Toss your filter & grind
Add your booze and swirl it around like the hipster you are. Serve over ice in a beaker or something pretentious.

notes: (requires Chemex or V60 w/ carafe w/ a food scale)

recipes.title: Piña Colada
recipes.headnote: I want a Piña Colada almost every day of this goddamn existence.

items: Throw it all in a blender.

notes: Get a mason jar out of your cupboard, go to Goodwill, and find a blender with a pitcher that has the same threading as your mason jar. It’s probably going to be an old Oster line. Buy it. Toss the pitcher and whatever Ninja bullshit you bought in college. Now you have a blender that you can fix yourself with some light googling, get parts at any Goodwill, and instead of dealing with that fat pitcher fuckery, you can just screw on literal mason jars and toss them in the dishwasher when you’re done. Added bonus is a 32oz mason jar already has the 100ml markings on it.
